name: highnoon-dust-layer

footage.look: Photoreal desert dust: fine pale ochre grains lit by hard overhead sun, translucent, with soft edges that thin to nothing; no other object, no ground plane, no sky, no texture: the background stays pure flat black for the whole clip.
footage.physics: Physics: the dust devils are spinning columns of dust that stay in the lower third of the frame, travel at a walking pace, never rise above the middle of the frame, and dissolve to nothing before the clip ends; nothing else exists; the frame is completely black at the start and completely black at the end.

notes: The dust-devil LAYER for the High Noon saloon redo (Colby, 2026-09-09 17:5x: the dust must pass in front of everything). Generated over pure black with a black first and last frame so it loops on an empty frame and composites in front of the still with a screen blend; 720p is enough for soft dust.

render.prompt: Static camera, locked off, no push, no zoom, no pan, one continuous take. On a completely black, featureless background, a small dust devil, a spinning translucent column of pale ochre desert dust about a quarter of the frame tall, enters at the right edge in the lower third of the frame in the first second, travels steadily leftward across the whole width at a walking pace, spinning, shedding wisps that fade, and leaves at the left edge by the sixth second; a second, smaller dust devil follows the same path from the right edge starting at the fourth second and leaves at the left edge by the ninth second; after it, only a few fading wisps, and the frame is completely black again for the last second. The background never changes: no ground, no horizon, no shadow, no texture, only black. Photoreal desert dust: fine pale ochre grains lit by hard overhead sun, translucent, with soft edges that thin to nothing; no other object, no ground plane, no sky, no texture: the background stays pure flat black for the whole clip. Physics: the dust devils are spinning columns of dust that stay in the lower third of the frame, travel at a walking pace, never rise above the middle of the frame, and dissolve to nothing before the clip ends; nothing else exists; the frame is completely black at the start and completely black at the end. No text, no logos.
render.negative: ground, floor, horizon, sky, landscape, shadow on the background, texture, gradient, grey background, objects, people, animals, text, logos, camera movement, zoom, pan, cut
